overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the one-on-one text exchanges during the February 2 meeting never reached a quorum of the five-member Board, and no serial deliberation was shown.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Board members deliberated by text message during the February 2 virtual meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, none of the text conversations we reviewed surrounding the February 2 meeting contained or reached a quorum of the Board, which is three members.

allegations.summary: Whether the text exchanges created a serial deliberation chain among a quorum of the five-member Board.
allegations.key_passage: we find no evidence of serial deliberation among a quorum of the Board, because Chair Cyr did not share the substance of his communications with either Vice Chair Etelman or Member Miles with any other member.
